Purity is exactly omega0=boundary measure+swept interior measure. In disk coordinates the swept Poisson density must be<=1 and the boundary remainder is forced;interior mass need not vanish.

A positive harmonic kernel has integral1 and is>=1/(4r) on a radius-r disk cap. This gives mass<=4r,including bulk,and controls real-seed parameters mapped to regular analytic outer arcs. Polynomial critical parameters cannot map there on cores of dimension<=3.

An explicit quartic polynomial loop has a reflex join and a small inward continuation. Giving that interior branch density1-|psi(p(t))| bounds its swept density by2delta<1/2;the positive boundary remainder supplies an exact positive full-support interval pure law in every order.

For every finite Gamma,gr C[SL2]^Gamma is the invariant subring of the determinant-zero cone domain. Minimum matrix degrees add under multiplication and multiply under nonconstant univariate composition.
The fixed bad seed-power marker therefore has original matrix degree<=D-H<=D-8 orD-12. At least one marker in ANY basis of that finite original filtered space has an infinite nonzero tail.
